sentences.text: The applicant is apprehending his arrest in the aforesaid crime, has knocked the portal of this Court for grant of anticipatory bail.

4. Allegation against the applicant is that he is also involved in the aforesaid offence wherein accused persons abducted and co-accused Thansingh committed rape with the prosecutrix and also allegation of providing shelter and threatening the prosecuttrix.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and he has falsely been implicated in this case.
The name of the applicant is not mentioned in the FIR.
After recovery, the statement of prosecutrix under Section 161 of Cr.P.C was recorded, wherein she has not mentioned the name of the applicant.

For the first time, she has taken the name of the applicant in her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C, in which she has stated that the applicant was also present along with main accused Thansingh and Viphul.

It is further submitted that Thansingh and Viphul have already been enlarged on bail by trial Court and co-accused Mithu Bhabar has also been granted bail vide order dated 11.08.2023 passed in M.Cr.C. No. 34917/2023 by this Court.
Charge sheet has been filed, hence there is no requirement of the applicant for investigation.
Under these circumstances, counsel prays for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant.
6. Learned counsel for the State has also opposed the prayer and prayed for its rejection, however, it is fairly admitted that the applicant has not past criminal antecedents.

7. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, the nature of allegation against the applicant, I am of the view that it is a case, in which applicant may I am of the view that it is a case in which applicant may be released on anticipatory bail.
Consequently, this first application for anticipatory bail filed on behalf of applicant is hereby allowed.

8. It is directed that in the event of arrest applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with two solvent sureties in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five thousand only) (out of which one local surety) to the satisfaction of the Arresting Authority.

The applicant shall comply with the following conditions:-
(i) that he shall make himself available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required.
(ii) that he shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer.

(iii) the applicant shall further abide by the other conditions enumerated in sub-Section (2) of Section 438 of Cr.P.C.
(iv) failure of compliance of any of the aforesaid conditions, shall entail dismissal of bail order automatically.
